mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate at or below 0.1% reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as capital costs decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 6.0% signals labor market deterioration that triggers equity sell-offs, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in GDP (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising GDPC1 and HOUST fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, industrial production (INDPRO) below 100.0 index level signals weakening manufacturing activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO is below 100.0 during late-cycle expansion.

mechanism_narrative: Higher real sales of consumer goods (RSAFS) levels indicate strong consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals accelerating price pressures that prompt central bank tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL yoy exceeds 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicate labor market contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining PAYEMS and rising UNRATE fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles, federal funds rate above 1.0% per annum signals reduced liquidity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.0% during monetary tightening cycles.
